title: Exercise Ends
prompt:
The whistle or signal ends the exercise. Students lower padded training markers and relax into uneven but functional spacing. Byleth stays calm while the Blue Lions realize they coordinated better than expected.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle. Transition in: whistle resolves tactical chaos. Transition out: cut to Felix processing Byleth. Screen/camera rule: left-to-right tactical geography; action returns to Byleth as anchor. Audio bridge: whistle, training weapons, bowstring, controlled breaths. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Camera: wide hold with dust settling.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: victory pose, cheering spectacle, injuries. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra.
